google.title: Google Drive setup
google.subtitle: A one-time setup so everyone on this FolderPilot can click “Connect Google Drive”. About 10 minutes.
google.fromEnv: Keys come from this server's environment.
google.notAdmin: Google Drive isn't set up on this server yet. Ask the person who set up this FolderPilot server (the first account) to open Admin → Google Drive setup.
google.intro: Google only lets registered apps into a Drive, so FolderPilot needs its own “OAuth client” from your Google account. Each button opens the right page in Google Cloud in a new tab; come back here after each step.

step1.title: Create a Google Cloud project
step1.body: Sign in with your Google account, name the project “FolderPilot” and click Create. Already have one? Pick it in the project list at the top and skip this step.

step2.title: Turn on the Google Drive API
step2.body: Check the project name at the top, then click the blue Enable button.

step3.title: Set up the Google sign-in screen
step3.body: Click Get started. App name: FolderPilot · User support email: yours → Next. Audience: External → Next. Contact information: your email → Next. Tick the agreement → Continue → Create. (If it shows an overview instead of Get started, this is already done.)

step4.title: Add yourself as a test user
step4.body: Scroll to Test users → + Add users → type the Gmail address(es) whose Drive you'll connect → Save.

step5.title: Create the keys (OAuth client)
step5.body: Application type: Web application · Name: FolderPilot. Under Authorized JavaScript origins click + Add URI and paste the first address below. Under Authorized redirect URIs click + Add URI twice and paste the other two.
step5.after: Click Create. Google shows a Client ID and a Client secret — keep that window open for the next step.

step6.title: Paste the keys here
step6.body: Copy both from Google's window (you can find them again under Clients → FolderPilot). FolderPilot checks them with Google before saving.

google.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it yourself.
google.secretSaved: Saved — paste a new one to replace it
google.saved: Saved. Google Drive is ready — connect it from New → Connect a source.
google.savedUnverified: Saved, but Google couldn't be reached to check the keys. Try connecting; if Google refuses, paste them again.
google.removed: Google keys removed. Connected Drives stop syncing until new keys are saved.
google.note: While the app is in Google's Testing mode, only the test users you added can connect, and Google asks them to sign in again every 7 days. Sign in with Google (on the sign-in page) still uses keys from the server environment.
